_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in real values. Never commit config.json (gitignored). All paths are absolute; ~ is not expanded.
_shadow_mode_note: When true, FIRE_VB_CALL handler logs intended fires to workflow_node_log but does NOT insert into wf_pending_actions. Default true for safety; flip to false ONLY after Phase 12 shadow run + Sahil 'go'.

db._vibrium_db_note: Read-only from workflow code, except for the additive customer_call_audit table (Phase 1 migration 002).

clevertap._creds_file_note: Same file the adhoc system uses. Override at runtime via CT_CREDS_FILE env var. File contains account_id + passcode; not committed.

redshift._creds_file_note: Reused for collection_comment_data reads in workflow_ingest. Override via REDSHIFT_CREDS_FILE env var.

executor._tick_batch_limit_note: Max workflow_runs advanced per tick; cap surfaces in Phase 8.5 alerts when reached repeatedly.

scheduler._window_note: 08:00-19:00 IST hard rule (RBI Fair Practice Code). Enforced by pre_call_gate.is_callable_now().

enrollment._hard_abort_note: Any single tick that would create > hard_abort_threshold runs exits non-zero + alerts (Phase 8.5). Override needs --force flag + Sahil 'go'.

alerts._smtp_note: Loaded only by the alerts daemon; workflow code does not import smtplib directly.
